0022600098.text: The Detroit Pistons, playing away at the Miami Heat, have not yet played a 2026-27 game, and Taurean Prince is out for personal reasons after averaging 9.2 points and 23.5 minutes per game last season. Miami has also not played this season. In 2025-26 the Pistons lost the season series 1-2, including a 121-110 loss in Miami on March 8, 2026.
